description: Transcribe a public https link to an audio or video file with speech-to-text. Use it for a direct media URL (ending in .mp3, .m4a, .wav, .mp4, .webm and similar); not for YouTube or other web pages, which use transcriptlab_get_transcript. Spends credits per audio minute. Returns a media_id: poll transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript with it, waiting a few seconds between tries and stopping after about ten.

diarize.description: Label speakers; defaults to false. Implies tier=premium.

lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1 spoken language hint (e.g. "ar", "en", "es"); omit or "auto" to auto-detect.

tier.description: Speech model tier; defaults to auto (normal when available).

url.description: Public https URL of an audio or video file.

name: transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url
title: Transcribe a direct media link
